description: This file contains unit tests for the React component 'App' using the '@testing-library/react' testing framework. It tests the rendering of the app title and the functionality of a theme toggle button.

methods.name: test('renders app title')
methods.description: Tests that the app renders a heading with the title containing 'notes'.

methods.name: test('renders theme toggle and toggles label')
methods.description: Tests that the theme toggle button is present and that clicking it updates its aria-label attribute.
